english.meaning: next; the following, before a measure word
english.note: 下個月 'next month'; 下個禮拜 'next week'.

exampleSentences.english: Because next week it’ll become 《無字頭七八九》.
exampleSentences.traditional: 因為下個禮拜呢會變成《無字頭七八九》啊。
